identificationModule.briefTitle: Exemestane Plus Everolimus for Hormone-receptor Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Open-label Pilot Study Evaluating the Maintenance Therapy With Exemestane Plus Everolimus After Induction Chemotherapy in Patients With Hormone-receptor Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer

leadSponsor.name: Organisation for Oncology and Translational Research

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether exemestane plus everolimus are effective in the treatment of patients who have achieved disease stabilization after induction chemotherapy for hormone-receptor positive metastatic breast cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Postmenopausal women with HR-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer achieving clinical benefit after the induction chemotherapy for visceral disease with sign(s) and/or symptom(s) will be recruited to receive study the maintenance treatment of everolimus plus exemestane.

conditions: Hormone Receptor Positive Malignant Neoplasm of Breast

armGroups.label: Exemestane plus Everolimus
armGroups.description: Exemestane 25 mg daily in combination with Everolimus 10 mg daily until disease progression or intolerable toxicity

interventions.name: Exemestane
interventions.description: Commercially available exemestane was supplied to sites as 25-mg tablets according to local regulations.

interventions.name: Everolimus
interventions.description: Everolimus was administered by continuous oral dosing of two 5-mg tablets or one 10-mg tablets.

primaryOutcomes.description: defined as from date of treatment initiation with everolimus plus exemestane to the date of progression or death if no documented disease progression
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Every 8 weeks in the first 24 weeks of treatment and every 12 weeks thereafter, up to 8 months (estimated)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: date of treatment initiation with everolimus plus exemestane until the date of death, censored at the last date known alive, whichever came first, assessed up to 32 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse Events (AEs)/Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Continuous during the study, up to 28 days after the last treatment
